description: First nanochat_exps experiment. Reproduces the MinimalGPT (vanilla GPT-2 baseline) from nanochat_walkthrough.ipynb Part 4. Uses nanochat's BPE tokenizer (V=32768, ClimbMix) and BOS-aligned best-fit dataloader. Provides a clean fp32-matmul baseline at the new vocab+data setup that future LUT-based experiments will compare against.
